title: 3M knew for more than 50 years that its products could harm humans, Australian government alleges in court documents

paragraphs.en: Manufacturing company 3M knew more than 50 years ago that its firefighting products – including components in Pfas “forever chemicals” – could be hazardous to the health of humans and animals and damage the environment, the federal government has claimed in court documents.
paragraphs.zh: 澳大利亚联邦政府在法庭文件中声称，制造企业3M公司在50多年前就已知晓其消防产品——包括Pfas“永久化学品”中的某些成分——可能危害人类和动物的健康，并损害环境。

paragraphs.en: In filings as part of its $2bn lawsuit against the multinational company, commonwealth lawyers said products sold to Australia were known to stay present in water and soil, were persistent in the human body and in animals, and contributed to conditions including reduced kidney function, alterations in immune function, effects on fertility and puberty and lower birth weight in babies.
paragraphs.zh: 作为其针对这家跨国公司20亿美元诉讼的一部分，联邦政府的律师在呈交文件中表示，出售给澳大利亚的产品已知会残留在水和土壤中，会在人体和动物体内持久存留，并会诱发包括肾功能下降、免疫功能改变、影响生育能力和青春期发育以及婴儿出生体重偏低等一系列健康问题。

paragraphs.en: In May, the attorney general, Michelle Rowland, announced the federal government was suing 3M and its Australian subsidiary over Pfas chemical contamination at 28 defence bases, seeking damages of more than $2bn (US$1.4bn).
paragraphs.zh: 今年5月，总检察长米歇尔·罗兰宣布，联邦政府正就28个国防基地的Pfas化学污染起诉3M公司及其澳大利亚子公司，索赔金额超过20亿美元（合14亿美元）。

paragraphs.en: The government alleges the use of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, known as Pfas, in firefighting foam has caused major environmental and economic harm, resulting in the largest legal claim brought to date by the Australian government.
paragraphs.zh: 政府声称，在灭火泡沫中使用全氟和多氟烷基物质（即Pfas）已造成重大的环境和经济损失，这是澳大利亚政府迄今提出的最大规模的法律索赔。

paragraphs.en: Three key Pfas chemicals were banned in Australia last year due to long-running concerns about environmental contamination and health risks.
paragraphs.zh: 由于长期存在的环境污染和健康风险担忧，澳大利亚去年已禁用三种关键的Pfas化学品。

paragraphs.en: The massive statement of claim lodged in the federal court revealed the government will argue 3M’s aqueous film-forming foam – referred to as AFFF – was known to be potentially damaging to the environment and causative of adverse health effects in humans, and that the company’s Australian operations should have known no later than 1973.
paragraphs.zh: 这份提交至联邦法院的冗长索赔声明显示，政府将主张，3M公司的水成膜泡沫灭火剂（简称AFFF）已知可能对环境造成损害，并对人体健康产生不利影响，而该公司在澳大利亚的业务最迟应在1973年之前就认识到这一点。

paragraphs.en: Exhaustive research by government lawyers – detailed in more than 1,600 pages of filings – claim internal company documents included warnings about the products being toxic. One document in April 1981 showed 3M was not permitting women “of child bearing potential” to work at one of its plants in Alabama, “so they will not be exposed to a type of fluorochemical that can cause birth defects in rats”.
paragraphs.zh: 政府律师进行了详尽调查——详载于超过1600页的呈交文件中——声称公司内部文件中包含有关这些产品具有毒性的警告。一份1981年4月的文件显示，3M公司不允许“有生育能力的女性”在其阿拉巴马州的一家工厂工作，“以免她们接触到一种能在大鼠体内导致出生缺陷的氟化学品”。

paragraphs.en: Pfas are found in a wide variety of household and industrial products. The more than 14,000 compounds are difficult to break down and persist in the environment for long periods. Some such as PFOA, one of the chemicals now banned in Australia, have been identified as cancer-causing in humans.
paragraphs.zh: Pfas广泛存在于各种家用和工业产品中。这超过1.4万种化合物很难降解，会在环境中长期存留。其中一些化合物，如现在已被澳大利亚禁用的化学品之一PFOA，已被认定为对人类有致癌作用。
